summary: Iteration 9 (onboarding/auth/paywall polish) tested at 390x844 with the Spanish UI, as an anonymous guest. VERIFIED IN BROWSER: (1) Onboarding works through all 6 steps. The completion screen shows onboarding-free-note ('Empieza gratis. Premium es opcional y puedes activarlo cuando quieras.') above the recommendations, and the sticky start button stays in view (y=782, h=48). (2) /learn: a MutationObserver saw learn-loading go false->true->false. None of the 25 rows ever changed data-state (no lock flicker); 20 are locked and 5 are free. Tapping a locked row as a guest opens premium-account-gate with the Google GIS slot and Apple, and no paywall. 'Ahora no' closes it. (3) premium-pending reproduced by delaying RevenueCat requests by 7s and tapping a locked item on /category/restaurant: the sheet shows 'Comprobando tu acceso…', no toast appears, and it resolves to the account gate. (4) /subscription as a guest goes ''->subscription-loading->subscription-free and never flips. There is no subscription-check-status-btn and no 'Restore' text. Upgrade as a guest opens the gate, not the paywall. (5) With RevenueCat aborted: subscription-unavailable note shows and upgrade is disabled. Learn still renders the list with free rows open. Tapping a locked row shows a calm toast 'Premium no está disponible ahora mismo. Inténtalo de nuevo.' and no sheet. A free lesson still opens. No CRA overlay and no page errors. (6) /lesson/taking-a-drinks-order opens normally. A premium lesson URL as a guest goes ''->locked with no content flash. (7) Listening and speaking practice each make one request with free_only=true. (8) Home, Practice, Progress, More and Account load with no console errors and no raw i18n keys. ONLY BY JEST (not reachable as a guest): paywall content (Suscribirse CTA, RevenueCat annual and monthly prices, renewal note, Terms and Privacy links with target=_blank, no Restore), purchase, cancel and already-purchased flows, the signed-in 'Refresh subscription status' button, and identity-switch races. Jest: 63/63 pass. Backend: 410/410 pass via the throttled local runner. The 9 new keys are present in all 10 locales, and es paywall.subscribe='Suscribirse'.

ui_bugs.issue: The GIS button text is in English ('Continue with Google') in the Spanish UI. The other buttons, like 'Continuar con Apple', are localized. Pass the GIS locale (e.g. locale: language) to renderGisButton.

integration_issues.issue: Category.js renders locks while billing is still loading, with no skeleton (unlike Learn). Premium users could see a Free->Premium lock flicker on this page. It does correctly route taps to the pending sheet.

issues: The legacy top nav overflows: 'Inicio' crowds the logo and 'Practicar' is clipped.
Situation titles are shown in English ('Taking an order') in the Spanish UI. Probably pre-existing on this legacy page.

action_items: Optional: localize the Google GIS button (locale param).
Optional: give Category.js the same 'wait for access resolution' treatment as Learn (skeleton or neutral state while billing.status is loading), or retire the legacy page.
Optional: add a timeout or fallback to the premium-pending sheet in case a RevenueCat request hangs without ever erroring.
critical_code_review_comments: PremiumGate pending mode has no timeout. If RevenueCat neither resolves nor rejects, the spinner stays until the user closes it. Acceptable, but consider a timeout that falls back to the 'unavailable' toast.

Lesson.js access effect has no cancellation flag. A stale getLesson from the 'loading' pass could still call setData after the 'ready' pass. This is harmless in practice because the unresolved pass only sets data for free content.
A premium lesson URL triggers getLesson twice (loading pass, then resolved pass), which produces duplicate 403 console entries. Expected, but noisy.
BillingContext.refresh() sets status 'ready' unconditionally, so a successful refresh after an outage recovers. Good. It doesn't update resolvedFor, which is fine because the identity hasn't changed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested guest flows verified; jest 63/63

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/run_local_throttled.sh. If the tool times out, run it with setsid nohup and skip files that already have XML in /tmp/pyrun. To reproduce premium-pending, delay **/*revenuecat*/** by ~7s and tap a locked button on /category/restaurant, because Learn shows a skeleton while loading. Language is set via localStorage iph_lang='es'. The paywall can't be reached as a guest; it is covered by jest only.
